name: Atantri Communications Pvt Ltd
capabilities: Mixed signal RF IC Front End
india_angle: The company is headquartered in India and designs chipsets to be manufactured domestically in Indian semiconductor fabs.
summary: Atantri Communications Pvt Ltd specializes in designing advanced 4G and 5G semiconductor solutions, including mixed signal RF transceivers and DSP baseband technologies. Their products are tailored for domestic manufacturing in India and serve critical applications in RF/5G, IoT, and defense sectors.
